title: Projecting AI Task Completion to 2030
description: Interactive visualization showing exponential growth of AI task completion capabilities from 2019 to 2030, with time on the horizontal axis and projected horizons based on 7-month doubling time
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Artificial Intelligence
Exponential Growth
AI Capabilities
Technology Forecasting
learningObjectives: Interpret the chart axes, reading year on the horizontal axis against the task-completion horizon in minutes, hours, or days on the vertical axis
Explain why a doubling time of roughly 7 months implies exponential rather than linear growth in AI task length
Calculate the projected task horizon for a target year by repeatedly doubling from a known 2025 data point
Compare the linear and log scale toggles, and explain why exponential growth appears as a straight line on a log axis
Evaluate the limits of extrapolating the METR trend to 2030, given physical limits, diminishing returns, and other barriers
